CRITICAL Issues\n\n### Issue 1: Thread Safety Race Condition on `shouldCancel`\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:104`\n**Problem:** The `shouldCancel` property is read inside an async for-loop (background context) but written from `cancel()` which may be called from the main thread. This is a data race.\n```swift\nif self.shouldCancel {  // Read from background context\n    break\n}\n```\n**Fix:** Mark `shouldCancel` as `@MainActor` or use a thread-safe atomic.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 2: Silent File Overwrite\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:216`\n**Problem:** If the destination file already exists, it is silently overwritten with no warning.\n```swift\ntry imageData.write(to: finalDestinationURL)  // Overwrites without warning\n```\n**Fix:** Check if file exists and either prompt user or append a unique suffix.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 3: Unhandled Error in Drop Delegate\n**File:** `ContentView.swift:512`\n**Problem:** The `error` parameter from `loadObject` is completely discarded. Failed drops give no feedback.\n```swift\n_ = provider.loadObject(ofClass: URL.self) { item, error in  // error ignored\n    guard let url = item else { return }\n```\n**Fix:** Log errors or show a user-facing message on failure.\n\n---\n\n## 2. HIGH Issues\n\n### Issue 4: Missing URL Validation After Drop\n**File:** `ContentView.swift:515`\n**Problem:** Only checks UTType conformance but doesn't verify the URL exists or is accessible.\n```swift\nif UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension)?.conforms(to: .image) == true {\n```\n**Fix:** Add `url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()` check and proper cleanup, or verify file exists.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 5: HEIC cgImage Failure Not Propagated\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:235`\n**Problem:** `cgImage(forProposedRect:context:hints:)` can return nil, but no contextual error is provided if it fails before reaching `saveWithCGImageDestination`.\n```swift\nguard let cgImage = image.cgImage(forProposedRect: nil, context: nil, hints: nil) else {\n    return ProcessingResult(..., error: \"Failed to get CGImage\")  // Generic error\n}\n```\n**Fix:** Provide more diagnostic info if CGImage creation fails.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 6: Memory Pressure for Large Images\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:169`\n**Problem:** No check on image dimensions before creating a resized buffer. A 50,000x50,000px image would attempt to allocate ~10GB of memory.\n```swift\nlet resizedImage = NSImage(size: newSize)  // No size validation\n```\n**Fix:** Add maximum dimension check (e.g., 10000px) before processing.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 7: Custom Filename Collisions\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:260-264`\n**Problem:** Custom filename appends `index + 1` - if user processes batches with same custom name, collisions overwrite previous output.\n```swift\nbaseName = \"\\(custom)_\\(index + 1)\"  // Same naming pattern every run\n```\n**Fix:** Add timestamp or UUID to ensure uniqueness.\n\n---\n\n## 3. MEDIUM Issues\n\n### Issue 8: Deprecated `lockFocus`/`unlockFocus`\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:173-175`\n**Problem:** These AppKit methods are deprecated.\n```swift\nresizedImage.lockFocus()\nimage.draw(in: destRect, from: sourceRect, operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)\nresizedImage.unlockFocus()\n```\n**Fix:** Use `NSImage.draw(in:from:operation:fraction:)` directly, which handles its own graphics context.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 9: Results Never Cleared on Error Path\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:97`\n**Problem:** `results = []` is only set at the start of `resize()`, but if a second resize starts while previous results still exist, there could be mixing.\n**Fix:** Ensure results are cleared before each new operation.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 10: Drop Delegate Returns `true` Even on Failure\n**File:** `ContentView.swift:524`\n**Problem:** `performDrop` returns `true` regardless of whether any URLs were successfully added.\n```swift\nreturn true  // Always succeeds even if no images added\n```\n**Fix:** Return `false` if no valid URLs were processed.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 11: Quality Validation Gap\n**File:** `ContentView.swift:29`\n**Problem:** Quality slider allows `0.1...1.0` but if somehow out-of-range value is passed to resize, HEIC/JPEG encoding could fail silently.\n**Fix:** Validate quality is within `[0.0, 1.0]` before processing.\n\n---\n\n## 4. MINOR Suggestions\n\n### Issue 12: Hardcoded Fallback Width\n**File:** `ContentView.swift:481`\n```swift\nwidth = selectedPreset.width ?? 1080  // Magic number fallback\n```\n**Fix:** Use a named constant or handle `custom` preset validation explicitly.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 13: Unused `result` Variable in Loop\n**File:** `ImageResizer.swift:108`\n```swift\nlet result = await self.processImage(...)  // result not used except for appending\n```\n**Fix:** Directly construct and append rather than storing in intermediate variable.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 14: Missing Accessibility Labels\n**File:** `ContentView.swift` - Several interactive elements lack `accessibilityLabel`.\n**Fix:** Add labels to Picker controls and other interactive elements for VoiceOver.\n\n---\n\n### Issue 15: `FileSize+Ext.swift` Ambiguous Method Name\n**File:** `FileSize+Ext.swift:4`\n```swift\nfunc formattedFileSize() -> String  // Only works on Int64\n```\n**Fix:** Rename to `formattedFileSize()` on `Int64` explicitly since the Int extension delegates to it.\n\n---\n\n## Summary\n\n| Severity | Count |\n|----------|-------|\n| CRITICAL | 3 |\n| HIGH | 4 |\n| MEDIUM | 4 |\n| MINOR | 4 |\n\n**Overall:** The code is reasonably well-structured but has significant thread safety and error handling gaps.
